userModal.deactivateDesc: {username} is signed out of every device right away and cannot log in until you reactivate the account.
userModal.reactivateDesc: {username} can log in again. Any session they still hold is ended, so they must sign in again.
userModal.toAdminDesc: {username} will get full access to this console, including managing users and removing reviews.

userModal.deleteDesc: {username} is signed out everywhere and cannot log in. Their reviews, activity, watch logs and library are soft-deleted. This is recorded in the audit log.
userModal.reasonNote: The reason you enter is saved in the audit log.
userModal.eraseDesc: {username} is already deleted. Erasing removes the account for good: reviews, comments, likes, lists, follows, notifications and linked sign-ins are all removed, and the email and username become free to register again. Audit log entries stay, without the username or email.
userModal.eraseConfirmHint: Type the username exactly as shown, including capitals.
userModal.reasonHint: Don't enter personal data such as names, emails or contact details.

reviewModal.title: Delete this review?
reviewModal.desc: The review is soft-deleted and hidden from the app. The author is not notified. This is recorded in the audit log.
